title: Compounding of Offence by Central Authority

content.scenario: A consumer in India files a complaint with the District Commission regarding a defective product. The Central Authority identifies the offence to be compounded and the consumer pays the prescribed amount.
content.outcome: The Central Authority or any officer specially authorised by him compounds the offence, on payment of the prescribed amount.

user_queries: What is the procedure for compounding offences by the Central Authority?
How does the Central Authority decide to compound offences?
What happens after the Central Authority compounds the offence?
